Method of Attack: Exploitation of multiple vulnerabilities in Cisco Small Business RV Series routers allowing remote code execution, privilege escalation, command injection, authentication bypass, and denial of service
Use of proof-of-concept exploit code demonstrated at Pwn2Own Austin 2021 and OffensiveCon 2022
Impacted Systems: Cisco RV260P VPN Routers with PoE
Cisco RV340 Dual WAN Gigabit VPN Routers
Cisco RV340W Dual WAN Gigabit Wireless-AC VPN Routers
Cisco RV345 Dual WAN Gigabit VPN Routers
Cisco RV345P Dual WAN Gigabit POE VPN Routers
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in web-based management interface and SSL VPN module via crafted HTTP requests and insufficient input validation
Chaining of multiple vulnerabilities to gain root privileges or execute arbitrary commands remotely
